notes.title: July 2025 Devlog: Fixes and Updates
notes.content:

We’ve been working behind the scenes to make something truly special and relaxing. Here is what we’ve done for the past four months![/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/6ffe542432effcd008d0322476d0330d8eba4665.png"][/img][b]Patch up ![/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjust several UI like soup, storefront and inventory menu[/p][/*][*][p]Prologue cutscenes text and animation updates[/p][/*][*][p]Update dish information[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust serving and soup tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Hunting Adventure flow states[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust UI Hunting Adventure[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust UI Join Party at Guild[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust Hunting Adventure animation (Party & Monster)[/p][/*][*][p]Introduction of food tags and custom order[/p][/*][*][p]Introduction of restaurant worker[/p][/*][*][p]Character introduction Hieu, Uxia and Uika[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Foraging Minigame[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]On development ![/b][/p][list][*][p]Added chapter 1 cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Hunting Micro Mechanics (Action Order, Stagger Bar and Flee Mechanic)[/p][/*][*][p]Landmark and Sub-Landmark system for Party Adventure[/p][/*][*][p]Added Boss Monster during Hunting Party Adventure[/p][/*][*][p]Added Skill Tree[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/b190f8ea9bbf8161e6748ae22d053de640ee6c35.png"][/img][/p][p]As Sunny Side Crossing continues to grow, your feedback is essential to helping us improve the gameplay and community experience. If you’ve got suggestions, questions, or ideas, don’t hesitate to let us know! Drop by our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2FFTAEn5e7hA"]Discord server[/url], fill out the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ikadev.studio%2Fssc-feedback"]feedback form[/url], or join the conversation on our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2648440/discussions/?snr=2___"]discussion page[/url]. See you in Sunny Side Crossing![/p][p][/p][p]Stay sunny! Sampai jumpa![/p][p][b]Ikadev Studio[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: March Devlog: Fresh Updates & Exciting Features in Sunny Side Crossing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/e030e121865a2b31d75e05c8c811d7c48ced5bbc.png[/img]
[b][h1]Dear newcomers and residents of Sunny Side Crossing,[/h1][/b]
It has been 3 months since our last update! We have been working tirelessly to create a cozy enjoyable game for all. So, here’s an update on what we’ve been working on since January 2025!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/78cec25361132a18b9f231ffc730f99c30c47eb7.png[/img]
[b][h2]Patch up ![/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Revamped save load system
[*] Updated character animations for various actions.
[*] Updated dialogue popup
[*] Adjusted display of debt task
[*] Revamped battle system: turn order, stagger effect, expedition node and cruising
[*] Adjusted battle animation speed
[*] Added new ingredients and dishes
[*] Adjusted dish price
[*] Adjusted displayed merchants goods in bazaar
[/list]

[b][h2]On development ![/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] Update story up to Chapter 1.
[*] Introduction of a helper system in the restaurant.
[*] Add new environments.
[*] Add an expanding backpack for adventure.
[*] Add a new food tag system for ingredients and dishes.
[*] Adjust food serve time.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/595ca9668894ef03d97bdcd9c1c8588390e897ab.png[/img]
We would love and appreciate your feedback through our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2648440/discussions/?snr=2___]discussion page[/url], [url=https://discord.com/invite/FTAEn5e7hA]Discord community[/url], or the [url=https://www.ikadev.studio/ssc-feedback]feedback form[/url] on our website. Feel free to share your thoughts as it will play a key role in helping us refine and create a better Sunny Side Crossing game. We look forward to welcoming you in our village. See you in Sunny Side Crossing!

Stay sunny! Sampai jumpa!
[b]Ikadev Studio[/b]

notes.title: Newest Build and New Year Roadmap; Let’s Celebrate!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/a3195fd629745d8c87039deeec872d5ff1442525.jpg[/img]
[h1]Dear newcomers and residents of Sunny Side Crossing,[/h1]
We can’t believe half a month of January 2025 has passed! But still, as part of our excitement for welcoming 2025, we want to share our latest game update (v0.90) with you. Here’s what’s new:
New Addition: 
[list]
[*] Added Fiery Feather hunting aftermath cutscene
[*] Added calendar on task
[/list]

Patch Up:
[list]
[*] Adjusted overlayed battle text feedback 
[*] Adjusted several character animations in battle and cutscene
[*] Hunting tutorial adjustment
[*] Adjusted several dialogues on cutscenes
[*] Revamped bake icon feedback
[*] Updated soup assets
[*] Adjusted task menu
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] No longer stuck on hunting fiery feather cutscene
[*] Able to switch targets on battle cutscene 
[*] Rabbit monster will take damage when attacked
[*] Several game environments match with cutscenes
[*] The gauge will be filled when starting the grill minigame
[/list]

We hope these updates make your time in Sunny Side Crossing even more enjoyable as we enjoy the new year together. 

[h2]Looking Ahead: Our 2025 Development Road[/h2]
To further maintain and improve our game, we’re thrilled to share our development roadmap for the first half of 2025!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/21357123176fe6f8e68f0c21259782be060dc460.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/29dea094df7d0ca6d3cd233ecba7201696a888aa.jpg[/img]

This roadmap represents our commitment to improving the game and bringing you exciting new content throughout the upcoming six months.

[h2]Your Feedback Matters[/h2]
We’re always eager to hear your thoughts and feedback. Share your ideas and suggestions through our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2648440/discussions/?snr=1_5_9_]discussion page[/url], [url=https://www.ikadev.studio/ssc-feedback]feedback form[/url], or on [url=https://www.ikadev.studio/ssc-feedback]Discord[/url]. 
Thank you for your incredible support. Let’s make 2025 even brighter together. Cheers to the new year, and see you in Sunny Side Crossing!

Stay Sunny! Sampai Jumpa!
[b]Ikadev Studio[/b]

notes.title: Play the Sunny Side Crossing Demo Today!
notes.content:
[h2]Dear newcomers and residents of Sunny Side Crossing,[/h2]
Your chance to try the game and help us build our village is here! 
Following the excitement of last month's Cooking Festival, we've released the game prologue as a demo for everyone to try. And here's the great news—our demo is here to stay! You can now play it anytime and share your valuable feedback to help us improve.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/34c0f1ba2335da4f5e21c11444454b5cb30aada6.jpg[/img]

Since then, we have updated our game based on all your precious feedback.  Here are the latest updates for Sunny Side Crossing (v0.80).
[list]
[*] Opening cutscene now is speed up and can be skipped.
[*] Customer serving time is adjusted to accommodate players better.
[*] Improve task UI/UX with direction hint in the map to better guide player. 
[*] Polished and rewrite fishing and hunting tutorial.
[*] Restaurant and guild environment visual update.
[*] Adding more of the characters expressions 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116459/64ffe530873185d8f3bed12f7d90ccc8e381839d.png[/img]

We would be deeply grateful if you could share your feedback with us through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2648440/discussions/]discussion page[/url], [url=https://www.ikadev.studio/ssc-feedback]feedback form[/url], or on [url=https://discord.gg/FTAEn5e7hA]our discord[/url]. Your inputs will help us make Sunny Side Crossing even better!
We can’t wait to see you join our village! See you in Sunny Side Crossing!

Stay sunny!  Sampai jumpa!
[b]Ikadev Studio[/b]
